title: 第12章  震惊的众人
slug: 爹仙尊娘魔尊我嘎嘎乱杀
content_zh:
如同蝗虫一般的虫魔发出凄厉的叫声，蜂拥而来；飞天夜叉们手握骨头制作的长矛，露出嗜血的笑容；
体型庞大如山、皮肤犹如熔岩龟裂的熔岩巨魔每一步踏在虚空都引发波纹震荡，一只只的独眼转动着毁灭的光芒；暗青色的雾气中一具具棺材漂浮着，震动的棺材中，尸魔伸出干枯的手；
血色的潮水啊，正在大地上蔓延着，血色的魔花竞相开放，朵朵魔花之中，钻出一个个嗜血的又魅惑人心的魅魔；
数百万魔族的威压叠加在一起，众人恐惧万分。
防御大阵刚刚破了，现在魔族大军压境，拿什么抵挡，完蛋了！
柳如烟吓得腿都软了，开什么玩笑？不是说佳孟关很安全的吗？怎么会？怎么会有这么多的魔族？她才筑基期啊！她不想死，她不想死在这里啊！
文婷、江浩、韩青也是脸色煞白，胆子都要碎裂了。
宋璇等人不是第一次来要塞的，但是他们也没经历过这样的场面啊，此刻也是吓得身体都在颤抖。莫说是他们了，就算在佳孟关驻守了几百年的高阶修士们，都没经历过这样的大阵仗。
魔族疯狂的袭来，没有防御大阵，他们毫无阻碍地杀入了要塞里面。一下子这要塞就成了地狱一般，修士和魔族激烈地厮杀了起来。
柳如烟尖叫着御剑就逃了，此刻没人说她，因为其他人也一样。但很快她就被一只魔族撞翻在了地上，亏得她的碧心佩护主，发出了青色光芒，击杀了扑向她的魔族。
她因为太害怕了，六神无主，直到有人将她拖走到了一处建筑内，她才想起了自己的傀儡，忙将谢逸给她的四具傀儡放出来保护自己。
“要塞已经完蛋了！”
“快逃啊！”
“快上战船逃走！”
众人疯狂地朝着战船哪里跑去。
杜信之前挨了孙铭一击，现在才从昏迷中醒来，看到魔族屠戮的血腥场面，脑袋嗡嗡作响，怎么办？怎么办？现在该怎么办？他胡乱地挥舞着长剑，斩杀周围的魔族，但是无法命令混乱的众人齐心协力地御敌。
霍嫣一边浴血奋战，一边思考着对策，心想，自己定要死在这里了。
“哈哈哈哈哈，今日你们都得死！”孙铭大笑。
他笑着笑着，就被一道身影近身，然后被一脚踹飞出去，嘭地一声砸穿了一面墙壁。孙铭从倒塌的废墟中站起身来，不敢置信地看着天空的少女。
谢莲心立在天空中，身上笼罩着青色的霞光，她穿着鲲鹏羽衣，这鲲鹏羽衣是顶级仙宝级别的仙衣，不仅仅能保护她，还能将她的速度提升到仙人级别，刚刚就是她踹了孙铭一脚。

天女们护在她周围，她冷冷地道：“你先死吧！”
谢莲心手一抓，右手的手心银色的光芒亮起，她手中就多了一把银白色的长剑了。她长发舞动，衣袂飘飘，瞬间就到了孙铭的面前，手中的长剑就朝着孙铭刺去，孙铭头一侧，闪过她刺来的长剑。
谢莲心剑势变化，再度朝着孙铭一剑刺去，她连攻了十招，虽然在鲲鹏羽衣的作用下，速度很快，只是未能对孙铭造成任何的伤害。孙铭冷笑了一声，用剑压将她震飞了出去。
天女们飞来，两个接住了谢莲心，其余的天女护卫在了谢莲心的旁边。
孙铭盯着谢莲心道：“鲲鹏羽衣？我知道你是谁了，玉阳仙尊的大弟子，谢莲心。”
“小丫头胆子挺大啊，区区元婴期就敢跟我打。只是就算你穿着鲲鹏羽衣，能提升的也就是速度而已，区区元婴期的力量，就算站着让你砍，你都破不了我的护体灵光。”
“好啊！有本事你站着别动啊！”谢莲心说着再度闪身出现在了孙铭的面前，鲲鹏羽衣霞光璀璨，拖出丝丝缕缕的青色仙光宛若飘带。
那孙铭还真的托大了，竟然真的不动。
谢莲心眼中闪过杀意，她那长剑之上忽然地爆发出来冲天剑意，剑气恐怖绝伦，冲霄而起，剑光似是霹雳一闪，快得无法比拟。
孙铭意识到了不好，用剑格挡的时候已经来不及了，就这么被这剑气斩成了两半，元神都未能逃离。
他身体变成了两半坠落，身后的天空也斩开了一道惊天的剑痕，飞在天空中的数个巨魔刚好挡在哪里，瞬间就被斩杀了。
魔族也好，修士也好，都呆滞了。
元婴期，一剑灭了一个渡劫期？
不，那不是她的力量。
那剑气是……
是的，这不是谢莲心的剑气，这是她父亲谢逸的剑气。
谢莲心来佳孟关之前，谢逸在她体内打入了三道剑气，加上小时候他打入她体内的两道剑气。她体内一共封印了五道谢逸的剑气，刚刚她那一剑用了五道剑气中其中一道剑气的四分之一。
众人还在没震惊完，谢莲心已经飞到了高空中了。
她手中的长剑高高地举过了头顶，剑气激荡化为了百万飞剑，百万飞剑在她身后形成了壮观无比的一个个巨大剑轮，剑光照耀天地。谢莲心的神识覆盖整个要塞内外，她大喝一声，剑气就如同暴雨般坠落。
每一把飞剑都精准击中了一个魔族，管你什么修为，都是一剑斩杀了。

一轮剑雨之后，要塞内外的魔族全部被斩杀。
霍嫣、杜信、宋璇、柳如烟等全部都目瞪口呆，众人脑子都空白了。
“这、这……”
众人都不敢置信自己看到的一切。
一招灭掉了百万魔族。
“是宗主师伯的剑气！”霍嫣道。
柳如烟在旁边听到了这话之后，妒忌得几乎要发狂。
剑气？为什么谢莲心能使出师尊的剑气？师尊将自己的剑气封印在谢莲心体内了？那为什么自己没有？如果自己也有师尊的剑气，那么此刻大出风头的人，是不是就是自己了？
不公平，这不公平。
谢逸的剑气不是任何人都能承受住的，也就是谢莲心是他女儿，不然绝对爆体。即使是谢莲心，他现在也顶多给她五道剑气而已。
谢莲心看着呆滞的众人，真是恨铁不成钢啊，她吼了一声：“都愣什么啊？修阵法啊！”
她用掉了剩下的四份之三的剑气，也就是说五道剑气中，她已经将其中一道剑气完全消耗掉了，现在她只剩下了四道了。
content_en:
The insect demons like locusts made a shrill cry and swarmed in; the flying yakshas held spears made of bones and showed bloodthirsty smiles;
The lava troll, which is as huge as a mountain and has skin as cracked as lava, causes ripples to vibrate in the void with every step it takes, and its one-eyed eyes turn the light of destruction; coffins float one after another in the dark blue mist, and in the shaking coffins, the corpse demon stretches out its withered hand;
The blood-colored tide is spreading on the earth, and the blood-colored magic flowers are blooming one after another. Among the flowers, bloodthirsty and charming succubi emerge one after another;
The pressure of millions of demons was superimposed, and everyone was terrified.
The defensive formation has just been broken, and now the demon army is pressing in. What can we do to resist it? It's over!
Liu Ruyan was so scared that her legs were weak. Are you kidding me? Didn’t it say that Jiameng Pass is very safe? How could it be? Why are there so many demons? She is only in the foundation building stage! She doesn't want to die, she doesn't want to die here!
Wen Ting, Jiang Hao, and Han Qing also turned pale, and their courage was about to burst.
This was not the first time for Song Xuan and others to come to the fortress, but they had never experienced such a scene. At this moment, their bodies were shaking with fear. Not to mention them, even the high-level monks who have been stationed at Jiameng Pass for hundreds of years have never experienced such a big battle.
The demons attacked crazily, and without any defensive formations, they entered the fortress without any hindrance. Suddenly the fortress became like hell, and the monks and demons fought fiercely.
Liu Ruyan screamed and ran away with Yu Jian. No one said anything to her at this moment, because everyone else did the same. But soon she was knocked to the ground by a demon. Thanks to her Blue Heart Protector, she emitted a cyan light and killed the demon that rushed towards her.
She was so scared that she was helpless. It wasn't until someone dragged her to a building that she remembered her puppets and quickly released the four puppets Xie Yi gave her to protect herself.
"The fortress is finished!"
"Run away!"
"Get on the warship and escape!"
Everyone ran frantically towards the warship.
Du Xin had been hit by Sun Ming before, but now he woke up from a coma. Seeing the bloody scene of the demon killing, his head was buzzing. What should he do? what to do? What to do now? He waved his sword indiscriminately, killing the demons around him, but he was unable to order the chaotic people to work together to defend against the enemy.
While Huo Yan was fighting bloody battles, she was thinking about countermeasures, thinking that she was going to die here.
"Hahahahaha, you will all die today!" Sun Ming laughed.
He was smiling and laughing when he was approached by a figure and then kicked out, smashing through a wall with a bang. Sun Ming stood up from the collapsed ruins and looked at the girl in the sky in disbelief.
Xie Lianxin stood in the sky, her body shrouded in cyan glow. She was wearing Kunpeng Feather Clothes. This Kunpeng Feather Clothes was a top-level immortal treasure-level fairy clothes. It could not only protect her, but also increase her speed to the immortal level. She had just kicked Sun Ming.
The goddesses guarded her, and she said coldly: "You should die first!"
Xie Lianxin grabbed it, and the silver light in her right hand lit up, and there was a silver-white long sword in her hand. Her long hair was dancing, her clothes were fluttering, and she was in front of Sun Ming in an instant. The long sword in her hand was stabbing at Sun Ming. The side of Sun Ming's head dodged her stabbing sword.
Xie Lianxin's sword force changed and she stabbed at Sun Ming again. She attacked ten times in a row. Although she was very fast under the influence of Kunpeng Yuyi, she failed to cause any damage to Sun Ming. Sun Ming sneered and used his sword to knock her away.
The goddesses flew over, two caught Xie Lianxin, and the other goddesses guarded Xie Lianxin.
Sun Ming stared at Xie Lianxin and said, "Kunpeng Yuyi? I know who you are, the eldest disciple of Yuyang Immortal Lord, Xie Lianxin."
"The little girl is quite courageous, she's just a mereHe dared to fight me when he was a baby. It's just that even if you wear Kunpeng Feather Clothes, all you can increase is your speed. With the power of a mere Nascent Soul stage, even if I stand and let you cut me, you can't break my body-protecting aura. "
"OK! If you can, just stand still and don't move! Xie Lianxin said as she appeared in front of Sun Ming again. Kunpeng's feathered clothes were shining brightly, dragging out strands of cyan fairy light like ribbons.
Sun Ming was really impressed, and he actually didn't move.
Xie Lianxin's eyes flashed with murderous intent, and her long sword suddenly erupted with soaring sword intent. The sword energy was terrifying and soared into the sky. The sword light flashed like a thunderbolt, so fast that it was incomparably faster.
Sun Ming realized something was wrong, and it was too late to block with his sword. He was cut in half by the sword energy, and his soul could not escape.
His body fell in two, and a shocking sword mark was cut in the sky behind him. Several trolls flying in the sky happened to be in their way and were killed instantly.
Both the demons and the monks were sluggish.
In the Nascent Soul stage, one sword destroyed an entire Tribulation stage?
No, that's not her power.
That sword energy is...
Yes, this is not Xie Lianxin's sword energy, this is her father Xie Yi's sword energy.
Before Xie Lianxin came to Jiameng Pass, Xie Yi injected three sword energy into her body, plus the two sword energy that he injected into her body when she was a child. There were a total of five sword qi of Xie Yi sealed in her body, and her sword just now used a quarter of one of the five sword qi.
Before everyone had finished being shocked, Xie Lianxin had already flown high into the sky.
The long sword in her hand was raised high above her head, and the sword energy surged into millions of flying swords. The millions of flying swords formed spectacular huge sword wheels behind her, and the sword light illuminated the heaven and earth. Xie Lianxin's consciousness covered the entire fortress inside and outside. She shouted loudly, and the sword energy fell like a heavy rain.
Each flying sword accurately hit a demon. No matter what your cultivation level, it was all killed with one sword.
After a round of sword rain, all the demons inside and outside the fortress were killed.
Huo Yan, Du Xin, Song Xuan, Liu Ruyan, etc. were all stunned, and their minds went blank.
"This, this..."
Everyone couldn't believe what they saw.
Killed millions of demons with one move.
"It's the sword energy of the sect leader and uncle! "Huo Yan said.
After Liu Ruyan heard this from the side, he was almost crazy with jealousy.
Sword energy? Why can Xie Lianxin use Master's sword energy? Master sealed his sword energy in Xie Lianxin's body? Then why don't you? If I also have the sword energy of my master, then am I the one who is in the limelight right now?
It's not fair, it's not fair.
Not anyone can withstand Xie Yi's sword energy, that is, Xie Lianxin is his daughter, otherwise she would definitely explode. Even if it is Xie Lianxin, he can only give her five sword energies now.
Xie Lianxin looked at the stunned people, she really hated iron and steel, she yelled: "Why are you so stunned? Repair the formation! "
She had used up three-quarters of the remaining sword energy, which meant that she had completely consumed one of the five sword energies, and now she only had four left.
